import json, glob, os
files = sorted(glob.glob('event-*.json'))[-40:]
for f in files:
    j = json.load(open(f))
    k = j.get('kind') or j.get('type')
    # try extract content
    txt = ''
    for key in ('message','content','thought','text','action'):
        v = j.get(key)
        if isinstance(v, str): txt = v; break
        if isinstance(v, list):
            parts=[]
            for p in v:
                if isinstance(p,dict): parts.append(p.get('text') or str(p.get('content'))[:200])
            txt = ' '.join(parts)[:400]; break
    print('---', f, k)
    print((txt or json.dumps(j)[:300])[:500])
EOF
